name: megascenes-retirement-card
description: Design retirement cards for a colleague, a friend or a parent, with their name, the years of work, your message and your signatures in the design.

interface.longDescription:
Give who the card is for, the years of work, the main line, a short message and how you sign it, and pick the look: elegant gold, beach and sunset, a golf course, a funny cartoon, minimal. You get a retirement card with your words set in the design, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For teams saying goodbye to a colleague, families celebrating a parent and friends starting a new chapter.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards or collect signatures from others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set the name, years, message and signatures in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: An elegant gold retirement card for Maria, 35 years, signed From all of us in Accounting
A funny cartoon retirement card that says Officially on permanent vacation
A beach and sunset card for my dad: Happy Retirement, enjoy every sunrise

positive.prompt: An elegant gold retirement card for Maria, 35 years, signed From all of us in Accounting. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one retirement card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A funny cartoon retirement card that says Officially on permanent vacation. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a retirement card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The retirement card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A golf course retirement card for Giorgio, square, with the words Happy Retirement, 40 years well done, signed The whole team. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my retirement card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my retirement card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
